title: Constructing Φ-RKA-Secure Identity-Based Encryption
summary: Known transformations make RKA-secure IBE an enabling primitive for related-key-secure signatures and CCA public-key encryption, but constructing such an IBE remains open.

formal_statement.body: Given a class $\Phi$ of related-key derivation functions, construct an identity-based encryption scheme that is secure against $\Phi$-related-key attacks, namely a $\Phi$-RKA-secure IBE scheme.

parameters: Φ: the class of related-key derivation functions against which security is required
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a Φ-RKA-secure identity-based encryption scheme.

citations.label: Cryptography Secure against Related-Key Attacks and Tampering

progress.summary: The paper explicitly leaves finding Φ-RKA-secure IBE schemes as an interesting open problem. It motivates them as enabling constructions for related-key-secure signatures and CCA public-key encryption.
citation_labels: Mihir Bellare et al., Cryptography Secure against Related-Key Attacks and Tampering
